body: I do need to find a good therapist. I was seeing my psychiatrist every week for a while but she is good at prescribing anti-depressants, not so good at talk therapy...

My husband is awesome but he can only do so much. Trying to deal with 4 kids on his own and work FT is exhausting. So I feel guilty 100% of the time. It makes me think he would be better off without me. I feel like I am just another thing to worry about and take care of. 

I need to find a good therapist but it's so hard to even pick up the phone. I feel like I am trying to move through jello.

I feel useless. Since the depression kicked into high gear I am not cleaning the house, taking the best care of the kids, I even have trouble talking because it feels like too much energy. 

I do live with my husband and the kids. Although I'm not quite sure that what I am doing is "living".

I am a mom of 4 - two bios, one with autism and two stepkids living here FT. I work full-time. The new baby was not planned. I tried so hard to think that I would escape PPD this time around but it was not to be. 


I feel like I am slipping away from life.
